baseline_models.focus_anchor: قضى ربك ألا تعبدوا إلا إياه وبالوالدين إحسانا
baseline_models.mechanism: A decisive lordly settlement joins exclusive worship to active beneficence toward both parents. The second clause is not an optional courtesy appended to theology; it is placed inside the same binding order, and ihsan demands positive good rather than bare non-injury.

activation_trace.role: The cutting judgment branch makes the opening a settled and binding frame for both clauses.
Lordship and mastery supply the authority under which worship and parental conduct are joined.
Humble obedient worship defines the exclusive vertical allegiance that immediately governs the human relation.
The two parents specifically identified through birth make embodied origin, not generic seniority, the relation at issue.
Beneficent and well-executed action, including surplus beyond strict justice, turns the clause into an affirmative practice.

changed_reading.before: The ayah gives a religious command followed by a family command.
changed_reading.after: The family command belongs to the same decisive settlement as exclusive worship, so theology is immediately tested as active excellence toward one's parents.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إما يبلغن عندك الكبر أحدهما أو كلاهما
baseline_models.mechanism: The duty intensifies when old age reaches its endpoint within the addressee's own sphere. Nearness removes abstraction, the weight of age increases vulnerability, and the one-or-both construction prevents either scale of need from escaping the command.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a temporal endpoint makes aging a reached condition that triggers the detailed speech duties.
Nearness and presence locate parental vulnerability inside the addressee's immediate field of responsibility.
Senescence and long duration identify the life-stage whose arrival changes the relation.
The branch of burdensome weight exposes why this stage can strain the caregiver and why restraint is specified.
Singularity keeps the duty fully active even when only one parent reaches the condition.
Dual encompassment closes the other case by including both parents without dilution of responsibility.

changed_reading.before: The ayah gives an age-contingent rule for speaking politely.
changed_reading.after: Old age arriving within one's own household or reach creates a non-evadable proximity duty, whether dependency appears in one parent or both.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فلا تقل لهما أف ولا تنهرهما وقل لهما قولا كريما
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence intercepts an escalation: a minimal sound of disgust, then forceful verbal expulsion, then an explicit replacement utterance. Silence is insufficient; the mouth must be retrained from reactive discharge into speech that actively confers honor.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance appears in prohibition, command, and object form, making voiced speech the controlled medium.
The smallest voiced discharge of weariness marks the earliest detectable point in the escalation.
Harsh verbal driving-away supplies the stronger aggressive endpoint that must also be blocked.
Honor, generosity, and pardon qualify the replacement speech as dignity-giving rather than merely neutral.

changed_reading.after: Interrupt the whole verbal escalation from reflexive sigh to forceful rebuke, then actively replace it with speech that restores and displays their honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns the focus into a developmental reversal. Those who raised the addressee through smallness now reach old age nearby; the presently stronger body lowers its side without humiliation, encloses them in mercy, and converts remembered nurture into present care and prayer.

activation_trace.role: Birth-origin identifies the pair whose earlier generative role is about to be reversed.
Old age supplies the later-life endpoint at which the direction of practical care changes.
Lowering after height turns the adult child's present strength into a deliberate downward movement toward the parents.
Wing as side, hand, and shelter gives the lowering an embodied protective shape.
Gentleness of side without abasement distinguishes chosen tenderness from degrading submission.
Tender mercy supplies both the motive for bodily lowering and the substance requested in prayer.
Feeding and gradual growth name the parents' earlier work that the adult child's care now answers.
Smallness opposite old age completes the life-course reversal between dependency at the two ends.

structural_cues: The old-age condition in 17:23 is immediately answered by the memory of being raised while small in 17:24.
The imperatives move from governing the mouth to lowering the body and then to prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies old age, smallness, nurture, lowered embodiment, and mercy; I supply the arrow from remembered upward nurture to transformed downward care. A live alternative is simple gratitude rather than a full role-reversal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The aged parent receives deference because of status and kinship.
changed_reading.after: The adult child reenacts care in reverse across the life course: remembered nurture is translated into gentle embodied protection when the former caregivers become vulnerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The absolute speech boundary is followed by inward knowledge, sound orientation, repeated return, and covering forgiveness. This preserves the prohibition while placing filial conduct inside a repairable discipline: inner resentment matters, outward polish alone is insufficient, and a lapse need not become permanent estrangement.

activation_trace.role: The involuntary-seeming sound of weariness exposes the boundary between inner pressure and voiced harm.
Overt speech remains the observable practice that must be changed rather than excused.
Disclosure to the knower moves evaluation behind the polished utterance into the agent's actual orientation.
The inward seat of thought and alarm supplies the hidden field known beneath speech.
Soundness opposed to corruption makes the relevant inner direction constructive rather than merely emotional.
Returning to a place of return makes correction repeatable after departure from the commanded manner.
Covering a fault and protecting its bearer from its residue keeps repair from becoming denial of the wrong.

structural_cues: 17:25 immediately follows the detailed parental speech commands.
The conditional sound orientation is paired with a plural description of habitual returners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward knowledge, soundness, return, and forgiveness; I supply the arrow from those cues to repair after failures in filial speech. The live alternative is that 17:25 offers general reassurance without specifically modeling such lapses.

changed_reading.before: The command is chiefly an external threshold governing which words may be uttered.
changed_reading.after: The threshold belongs to an inward and repeatable repair practice: intention is exposed, return remains possible, and forgiveness supports correction without weakening the ban on harmful speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding commands turn ihsan into a calibrated care economy. A relative's claim is a due right; when material giving is unavailable, accessible speech still preserves relation; generosity must avoid both a shackled hand and total extension; and capacity is measured rather than imagined as limitless.

activation_trace.role: Active beneficence supplies the focus practice whose material scope and limits are clarified by the sequence.
A binding entitlement changes kin-directed goodness from discretionary generosity into something owed.
Voiced speech remains an available act when the giver must turn away from a material request.
Ease after difficulty makes speech a low-friction form of care that keeps scarcity from becoming relational harshness.
The binding collar supplies the image of disabling restraint at one failed extreme of giving.
An entirely released hand supplies the opposite extreme of unbounded expenditure.
Restriction to a small measure introduces real capacity limits into the practice of provision.
The balance of justice supplies a governing metric between withholding and self-defeating excess.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from giving a relative's right, through graceful speech under inability, to the two extremes of the hand and finally to just measure.
Speech recurs as an act precisely where material transfer cannot occur.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies right, substitute speech, opposed hand positions, restricted provision, and balance; I supply the arrow back to parental ihsan as a sustainable allocation practice. A live alternative is that these are adjacent duties to other recipients rather than specifications of parental care.

changed_reading.before: Ihsan to parents means open-ended generosity and kind words.
changed_reading.after: Ihsan is an owed but calibrated practice: give within real capacity, never convert inability into contempt, and let dignifying speech continue care when material provision cannot.

context_deltas.mechanism: The birth-root changes roles from parents in the focus to children in 17:31. At one end of life, aged parents may strain the adult child; at the other, children may appear economically threatening. The paired sequence blocks a shared failure: treating a dependent generation as disposable when care becomes costly.

activation_trace.role: Parents viewed from the event of birth establish the older generation as one pole of the relation.
The burdensome weight of old age makes the potential pressure on the adult caregiver explicit.
Children as offspring reverse the birth-root's participant direction and expose the younger dependent generation.
Taking life supplies the extreme form of eliminating a dependent to escape perceived cost.
Fear with dread identifies the affective pressure that can turn provision anxiety into violence.
A hand stripped of wealth supplies the economic rationale under which the dependent is falsely recast as expendable.
Allocated provision counters the premise that survival must be secured by removing the other generation.

structural_cues: The same birth-root names parents in 17:23 and children in 17:31.
Both passages address pressure created by a dependent family member, but from opposite generational directions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root reversal, age-burden, poverty fear, killing, and provision; I supply the common anti-disposability rule across the two generations. A live alternative is to keep infanticide wholly separate from care of aged parents.

changed_reading.before: The focus imposes a one-way upward duty from adult child to aging parent.
changed_reading.after: It becomes one pole of a bidirectional intergenerational protection: neither generation may answer the other generation's dependency by erasure, contempt, or abandonment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated reaching verb marks opposite thresholds. In the focus, a parent reaches old age inside the child's care; in 17:34, an orphan reaches mature strength inside a guardian's custody. Fulfilment and a repeatedly maintained covenant recast power over a vulnerable person's affairs as temporary stewardship rather than ownership.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the endpoint introduces old age as one threshold at which another person's duty becomes active.
Senescence defines the late-life threshold and its altered practical dependency.
A child cut off from a caretaker supplies the contrasting vulnerable person placed under another's power.
The same reaching-to-an-endpoint branch links the two passages while the destination changes from old age to maturity.
Arrival at mature strength supplies the early-life threshold opposite parental senescence.
Completion without deficit makes stewardship answerable for returning every due intact.
Preserving something through repeated attention supplies the temporal discipline of trustworthy custody.

structural_cues: The exact root ب ل غ governs both reaching old age in 17:23 and reaching mature strength in 17:34.
The two complements point to opposite ends of a life course while each passage regulates power around vulnerability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reaching, opposite age thresholds, orphan custody, completion, and maintained covenant; I supply the analogy that parental care is likewise custodial rather than possessive. A live alternative is that the repetition only coordinates distinct legal thresholds.

changed_reading.before: The child owes kindness once a parent becomes old.
changed_reading.after: The child holds a stewardship at a late-life threshold, parallel to guardianship at the threshold before maturity: vulnerability grants responsibility, not ownership or unchecked control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ban on following what one does not know, followed by the accountability of hearing, sight, and heart, adds an epistemic brake to the focus speech sequence. Noble speech toward aging parents is not only gentle in tone; it refuses to turn partial perception, repeated frustration, or fault-tracking into confident accusation.

activation_trace.role: Overt utterance is the point where an untested judgment can become relational harm.
Harsh rebuke is the speech act whose apparent certainty and force require restraint.
Following an apparent trace supplies the mechanism by which incomplete evidence can harden into a claim.
Actual disclosure to the knower sets the evidentiary threshold that reactive interpretation may fail.
Hearing as understanding and response turns listening into accountable reception rather than ammunition.
Insight of the heart distinguishes surface observation from the deeper seeing needed before judgment.
The heart as an inward heat-center exposes the affective furnace from which rebuke can issue.
Questioning and demand make every sensory and inward input answerable for the speech built from it.

structural_cues: A command about utterance in 17:23 is later paired with a prohibition on pursuing the unknown.
Hearing, sight, and heart are individually named and then gathered under accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech control, non-pursuit without knowledge, accountable senses, and the heated heart; I supply the arrow from epistemic restraint to family speech under frustration. A live alternative is a general rule for testimony and belief with no special return to parents.

changed_reading.before: Noble speech is primarily a matter of respectful wording and tone.
changed_reading.after: Noble speech also requires epistemic discipline: listen, test what is known, and do not convert frustration or partial perception into a forceful verdict on aging parents.

context_deltas.mechanism: A deictic and theological frame closes around the focus. The parents reach old age 'at you,' while the sequence's evils are judged 'at your Lord.' The opening lordly settlement and exclusive worship return as revealed wisdom and the rejection of another deity. The domestic site is therefore a delegated field under divine evaluation, not the adult child's private sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Decisive judgment opens the unit as an authoritative settlement rather than private advice.
Lordship locates ultimate mastery above the adult child who may hold practical household power.
Near presence marks the child's immediate household sphere as the site where conduct occurs.
The repeated nearness construction relocates final assessment from what is at the child to what stands before the Lord.
Repeated lordship makes the household actor accountable to a higher owner and governor.
Divine non-acceptance supplies the evaluative polarity against the noble speech commanded in the focus.
Divinely given instruction identifies the intervening social commands as revealed guidance.
Accurate wisdom supplies the coherent governing intelligence of the whole command sequence.
Worship and the worshiped one restore the opening exclusivity and close the social ethic inside theology.

structural_cues: The construction عندك in 17:23 returns as عند ربك in 17:38.
The unit opens with a lordly settlement and exclusive worship, then closes by naming revealed wisdom and forbidding another deity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the deictic echo and theological bookend; I supply the arrow that makes the household a delegated jurisdiction under divine review. A live alternative is that the echoes close the whole command list without specifically intensifying parental care.

changed_reading.before: The adult child governs conduct within a private family relationship.
changed_reading.after: The parent's presence 'at you' is simultaneously conduct 'before your Lord': domestic power is delegated, bounded, and answerable to the lordship worshiped at the ayah's opening.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because كلاهما functions here as dual totality, while the sheltered-harbor branch is form-distant and must not replace that grammar. It remains anchored in the packet's ك ل و inventory, the focus's عندك, and the following lowered wing; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary spatial analogy.

activation_trace.role: Near presence gives the exploratory shelter image an actual domestic location.
Encompassing both preserves the construction's primary dual force before any secondary image is activated.
A harbor screened from wind supplies the contained image of receiving both vulnerable parents into protection.
Wing as shelter gives the imagined harbor a protective bodily canopy.
Lowering wing and voice turns shelter into a posture enacted through body and sound.

changed_reading.before: Whether one parent or both are present, the same rule applies.
changed_reading.after: As a contained spatial image, both parents arriving 'at you' can be received like vulnerable lives in a sheltered harbor, with lowered body and voice forming cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because تنهرهما plainly activates rebuke in context, while river-cutting and opening-to-flow are remote branches of the same root. The reading remains anchored in the focus's rebuke-to-noble-speech sequence and the later expansion, restriction, and balance imagery; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, never as the lexical sense of the verb here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ولا تنهرهما وقل لهما قولا كريما

activation_trace.role: Harsh verbal rebuke preserves the verb's primary contribution and supplies the force being regulated.
A river cutting earth with abundant flow supplies the exploratory image of speech force carving into vulnerability.
Opening and widening until flow is released models how an unchecked inner pressure becomes a verbal torrent.
Audible speech is the channel whose discharge is redirected from rebuke to a commanded replacement.
Good rain and fertile growth supply the counter-image of speech that nourishes rather than erodes.
Spreading and extension provide the first contextual control variable for released force.
Constriction to a limited measure provides the opposed control variable.
A just balance contains the flow analogy by requiring measured force rather than mere release.

changed_reading.before: Do not rebuke the parents; speak nobly.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material image, do not let accumulated pressure become a scouring verbal channel through their vulnerability; measure its force so speech nourishes rather than erodes.

strongest_changes: 17:24 changes deference into a life-course reversal in which remembered nurture becomes gentle embodied care.
17:26-35 changes ihsan from unbounded sentiment into an owed, sustainable, and measured care economy.
The birth-root reversal in 17:31 places aged parents and vulnerable children inside one intergenerational anti-disposability mechanism.
The echo from عندك to عند ربك places household power under divine lordship and review.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activations were structural rather than topical: opposite life thresholds linked by ب ل غ, generational role reversal through و ل د, speech retained as care when material giving fails, and the deictic transfer from the child's near-space to the Lord's evaluative presence.
remaining_uncertainties: The calibrated-care model may be a deliberate return to parental ihsan, or the sequence may chiefly coordinate distinct duties to distinct recipients.
The inward repair cues of 17:25 may specifically qualify filial lapses or may offer only general moral reassurance.
The harbor and hydraulic readings are intentionally contained branch activations; neither should displace the immediate grammar or primary lexical senses.
